name: friday-budgeting-pro
description: An OpenClaw skill that lets the user manage personal finances by chatting with HAL. Connects to banks via Plaid, auto-classifies transactions using a tiered engine (rules → LLM → ask user), stores everything in a local SQLite file, exports to Excel on request, runs a daily sync via an OpenClaw cron job, and pings the user when it needs help classifying something.
